narr.Aqua Kyoto Paris: W29 users 3,905 with 188 GA4 bookings; conversion rate 4.8%, the first uptick in four weeks even as traffic fell 13%. Google delivered 27 bookings at €24 CPA on €645 spend; Meta 32 at €57 on €1,816. Google spend dropped 36% week-on-week as the EN Performance Max campaign stopped delivering and non-brand search pulled back, so bookings fell to 27 — but CPA improved to €24, the best of the window, with budget concentrating on brand search. Meta held spend flat yet schedules slipped again to 32, pushing CPA to €57, the highest in the four-week window. Aqua Kyoto Paris launched late 2025, so there is no year-on-year comparison yet.
